name: popsicle
headline: seo-growth-tools: Automate SEO Article Publishing
short_description: automation of creating, formatting, and publishing SEO articles.  uses GPT-4 for content generation and DALL-E 3 for image creation.
author: gowthamsundaresan

sections.overview:
seo-growth-tools automates the entire workflow of creating, formatting, and publishing SEO-optimized blog articles. It integrates OpenAI's GPT-4 for content generation and DALL-E 3 for cover image creation, with Supabase managing article metadata and publication tracking. Users populate a Blog Queue table with SEO-focused titles, target keywords, meta descriptions, and image prompts, then the script generates and publishes complete articles to Next.js blogs. The tool supports both automated image generation and manual modes, converting raw content into HTML-formatted pages with optimized metadata, targeting bloggers and content teams seeking to scale SEO-driven publishing.
Scaling SEO blog content production with automated GPT-4 article generation
Publishing keyword-optimized articles to Next.js blogs without a CMS
Generating branded cover images using DALL-E 3 for each article
Managing article metadata and tracking publication status with Supabase
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/gowthamsundaresan/seo-growth-tools`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a 1,000-word SEO-optimized article about [TOPIC] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Include an introduction, 3-5 subheadings, and a conclusion. Use [KEYWORDS] naturally throughout the text. Also, create a featured image for the article using DALL-E 3. The image should be visually appealing and relevant to the topic.
```
